title: Pandavas or Kauravas: Who Did the Injustice?
description:
The Mahabharata is hailed as an epic tale of good triumphing over evil. But was it really? What if the Pandavas weren’t the righteous heroes we were taught to believe, and the Kauravas were the real victims of injustice?

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts takes a rational look at the Mahabharata through the eyes of the Kauravas. From the questionable birth of the Pandavas through Kunti’s mantra software, to Dhritarashtra handing them half the kingdom they didn’t deserve, the story begins with injustice. When the Pandavas gambled away their kingdom — not once but twice — they still returned to stake claims they had no right to .

We expose the bias and treachery in the war itself: Karna killed while unarmed, Drona deceived with a lie, Bhishma brought down by Shikhandi, Jayadratha slain through trickery, and Duryodhana struck below the belt. If this was dharma, what does adharma even mean?

This isn’t about glorifying villains, but about questioning blind faith and asking if we’ve fallen into confirmation bias by assuming Pandavas = justice and Kauravas = injustice. If you’ve searched for Mahabharata explained, Pandavas vs Kauravas, Mahabharata justice or injustice, treachery in Mahabharata, or #JusticeForKauravas, this video flips the perspective.

#JusticeForKauravas #MahabharataExposed #CriticalThinking #ScienceOverSuperstition #IndianMythology
